messages.subject: Interpreting proc.d.allometry results
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am looking at allometry patterns in cranial shape and am playing around with proc.d.allometry but I am not entirely sure I am interpreting all the ANOVA results I am looking at correctly. I have a group factor ("species") and was wondering what the correct way to interpret the p-values for size and for species would be. Am I correct in assuming that low p-values suggest that species and/or size have a significant effect on shape within the whole sample? How may I compare the respective influence on shape of species and size (if at all)?

Sorry if this seems a silly question, and thanks in advance!

Here is an example of the results I'm looking at:
